originalAlarm.description: The value written to `&irq` is never used.

presenceCondition:
(and (= CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE true)
     (= CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN false)
     (= CONFIG_OF_IRQ false))
model:
(define-fun CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE () Bool
  true)
(define-fun CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN () Bool
  false)
(define-fun CONFIG_OF_IRQ () Bool
  false)
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 6252547b8a7.c (Linux TWL4030). Dead store on 'irq' at line 12 ('int irq = *ops') inside irq_domain_add(), same workspace/config as PRODUCT_150 but different alarm type. TWL4030_CORE=true, IRQ_DOMAIN=false, OF_IRQ=false is a contradictory configuration: CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN is implicitly defined by CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE (lines 3-5), so TWL4030_CORE=true && IRQ_DOMAIN=false is impossible in practice. When IRQ_DOMAIN=false, irq_domain_add() body would not be compiled, yet the alarm fires at line 12 inside that body — the result of an impossible configuration analysis. Additionally, irq is assigned from *ops but never used (simplification artifact). The known NullDereference bug (ops=NULL when OF_IRQ=false) is a separate issue detected in PRODUCT_150.
